item.title: EplayerX 1.2.42
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 修复网盘媒体手动匹配后重复出现「电影」或「剧集」分类的问题。已有对应分类时会归入其中，同时保留自定义目录和混合内容目录。 - 修复合并多个网盘目录时，刷新自动分类可能选错来源的问题。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本。请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What’s New
- Fixed duplicate Movies and TV Shows categories after manually matching cloud drive media. Matched titles can join existing categories while custom folders and folders with mixed content keep their own groups. - Fixed an issue where refreshing an automatic category in a combined cloud library could select the wrong source.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
